fnol_text: My name is Yusuf O'Connell and I live at 709 Elmstead Drive, Greenville, SC 29615. You can reach me on (555) 590-3985 or yusuf.oconnell@example.com. On 7 September 2025 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2024-00019. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr O'Connell on (555) 590-3985 to acknowledge the claim. Yusuf confirmed the loss date as 7 September 2025.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Imogen Iyer gave a statement by phone.
Yusuf sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
